Is mein Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ki teen sifatein bayan hui hain, palne aur parwarish karne ki, malik aur shahanshah hone ki, ma'bud aur la'iq-e-ibadat hone ki. Tamam cheezein usi ki paida ki hui hain, usi ki milkiyat mein hain aur usi ki ghulami mein mashghool hain, pas woh hukm deta hai ke in pak aur bartar sifatein wale Allah ki panah mein aa jaye jo bhi panah aur bachao ka talib ho. Shaitan jo insan par muqarrar hai us ke waswason se wahi bachane wala hai, Shaitan har insan ke sath hai. Buraiyon aur badkariyon ko woh zeenat-dar kar ke logon ke samne woh pesh karta rehta hai aur behkane mein rah-e-rast se hatane mein koi kami nahin karta. Us ke shar se wahi mahfooz reh sakta hai jise Allah bacha le.

Sahih Hadith Shareef mein hai: Tum mein se har shakhs ke sath ek Shaitan hai. Logon ne kaha: Kya Aap ke sath bhi? Aap ne farmaya: Haan, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne us par meri madad farmai hai pas mein salamat rehta hoon, woh mujhe sirf neeki aur achhai ki baat hi kehta hai.

Bukhari Muslim ki aur hadith mein Hazrat Anas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki zabani ek waqia manqool hai jis mein bayan hai ke Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab i'tikaf mein the to Umm-ul-Mo'mineen Hazrat Safiyyah (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) Aap ke pas raat ke waqt aain, jab wapas jaane lagin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein awaz de kar thehraya aur farmaya: Suno! Mere sath meri biwi Safiyyah bint Huyayy (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) hain. Unhon ne kaha: SubhanAllah ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Is farman ki zaroorat hi kya thi? Aap ne farmaya: Insan ke khoon ke jari hone ki jagah Shaitan ghoomta phirta rehta hai, mujhe khayal hua ke kahin tumhare dilon mein woh koi badgumani na daal de.

Hafiz Abu Ya'la Mawsili (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jis mein hai Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Shaitan apna hath insan ke dil par rakhe hue hai, agar yeh Allah ka zikr karta hai tab to us ka hath hat jata hai aur agar yeh zikr-e-Allah bhool jata hai to woh us ke dil par poora qabza kar leta hai, yahii Waswas-ul-Khannas hai, yeh hadith ghareeb hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne gadhe par sawar ho kar kahin ja rahe the, ek Sahabi aap ke peeche baithe hue the, gadhe ne thokar khai to un ke muh se nikla Shaitan barbaad ho. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yun na kaho, is se Shaitan phool kar bada ho jata hai aur kehta hai ke mein ne apni quwwat se gira diya, aur jab tum Bismillah kaho to woh ghat jata hai yahan tak ke makkhi ke barabar ho jata hai. Is se sabit hua ke zikr Allah se Shaitan past aur maghloob ho jata hai aur is ke chhod dene se woh bada ho jata hai aur ghalib aa jata hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab tum mein se koi masjid mein hota hai is ke paas Shaitan aata hai aur ise thapakta aur behlata hai jaise koi shakhs apne jaanwar ko behlata ho, phir agar woh khamosh raha to woh naak mein nakeel ya muh mein lagaam chadha deta hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne yeh Hadith bayan farma kar farmaya tum khud ise dekhte ho, nakeel wala to woh hai jo ek taraf jhuka khada hua aur Allah ka zikr na karta ho aur lagaam wala woh hai jo muh khole hue ho aur Allah ka zikr na karta ho.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain Shaitan Ibn-e-Aadam ke dil par changal maare hue hai, jahan yeh bhoola aur ghaflat ki ke is ne waswase daalne shuru kiye aur jahan is ne zikr Allah kiya aur yeh peeche hata. Sulaiman farmate hain mujh se yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke Shaitan rahat-o-ranj ke waqt insaan ke dil mein suraakh karna chahta hai yani ise behkana chahta hai, agar yeh Allah ka zikr kare to yeh bhaag khada hota hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Shaitan burai sikhata hai jahan insaan ne is ki maan li phir hat jata hai.

Phir farmaya jo waswase daalta hai logon ke seene mein. Lafz Naas jo insaan ke ma'ni mein hai is ka itlaaq Jinnoon par bhi bataur ghalba ke aa jata hai. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'bi-rijalin minal-jinni' kaha gaya hai to Jinnaat ko lafz Naas mein daakhil kar lene mein koi qabahat nahin. Gharaz yeh hai ke Shaitan Jinnaat ke aur insaan ke seene mein waswase daalta rehta hai. Is ke baad ke jumle 'minal-jinnati wan-naas' ka ek matlab to yeh hai ke jin ke seenon mein Shaitan waswase daalta hai woh Jin bhi hain aur insaan bhi, aur doosra matlab yeh hai ke woh waswasa daalne wala khwah koi Jin ho khwah koi insaan, jaise aur jagah hai: (Wa kadhalika ja'alna likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwan shayateenal-insi wal-jinni yoohee ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhrufal-qawli ghurooran wa law sha'a rabbuka ma fa'aloohu fadharhum wa ma yaftaroon) (Surah Al-An'am: 112), yani isi tarah hum ne har Nabi ke dushman insani aur jinnati Shaitan banaye hain jo ek doosre ke kaan mein dhoke ki baatein bana sanwar kar daalte rehte hain.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas masjid mein aaya aur baith gaya, aap ne farmaya namaz bhi padhi? Mein ne kaha nahin. Farmaya khade ho jao aur do raka'at ada kar lo. Mein utha aur do raka'at padh kar baith gaya.

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Haan." Main ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Namaz kaisi cheez hai?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya: "Behtareen cheez hai, jo chahe kam kare jo chahe is amal ko ziyada kare." Main ne poocha: "Roza?" Farmaya: "Kaafi hone wala farz hai aur Allah ke paas ajr-o-sawab la-intiha hai." Main ne phir poocha: "Sadqa?" Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Bohat hi barha charha kar kai guna kar ke badla diya jaye ga." Main ne phir arz ki: "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Kaunsa sadqa afzal hai?" Farmaya: "Bawajood maal ki kami ke sadqa karna ya chipke se chhupa kar kisi miskeen faqeer ke sath sulook karna." Main ne sawal kiya: "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Sab se pehle Nabi kaun the?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam / A.S)." Main ne poocha: "Kya woh Nabi the?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Haan woh Nabi the aur woh bhi woh jin se Allah Ta'ala ne baat cheet ki." Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya: "Ayat-ul-Kursi (Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu, la ta'khuzuhu sinatuw-wa la naum, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man zal-lazi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-iznih, ya'lamu ma baina aideehim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuheetoona bi-shai'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-arda, wa la ya'ooduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azeem) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 255)." Yeh hadees Nasa'i mein bhi hai aur Abu Hatim bin Hibban ki Sahih Ibn Hibban mein to doosri sanad se doosre alfaaz ke sath yeh hadees bohat bari hai, Fallahu A'lam. Mere dil mein to aise aise khayalaat aate hain ke un ka zaban se nikalna mujh par aasman se gir parne se bhi ziyada bura hai." Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar, Allah hi ke liye hamd-o-sana hai jis ne Shaitan ke makr-o-fareeb ko waswase mein hi lauta diya." Yeh hadees Abu Dawood aur Nasa'i mein bhi hai. Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ke ihsan se yeh tafseer khatam hui. Wal-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil 'Alameen, Allah ke fazl-o-karam se teeswein paare ki tafseer bhi khatam hui aur Tafseer Ibn Kathir ka tarjuma Tafseer Muhammadi bilkul kamil ho gaya. Allah Ta'ala hum sab ko apne paak kalam ki sahih samajh de aur is par amal naseeb farmaye aur phir qabool kare. Ameen Ilahal-Haqq Ameen! Is ke baad ke jumle 'minal-jinnati wan-naas' ka ek matlab to yeh hai ke jin ke seenon mein Shaitan waswase daalta hai woh Jin bhi hain aur insaan bhi, aur doosra matlab yeh hai ke woh waswasa daalne wala khwah koi Jin ho khwah koi insaan, jaise aur jagah hai: (Wa kadhalika ja'alna likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwan shayateenal-insi wal-jinni yoohee ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhrufal-qawli ghurooran wa law sha'a rabbuka ma fa'aloohu fadharhum wa ma yaftaroon) (Surah Al-An'am: 112), yani isi tarah hum ne har Nabi ke dushman insani aur jinnati Shaitan banaye hain jo ek doosre ke kaan mein dhoke ki baatein bana sanwar kar daalte rehte hain.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas masjid mein aaya aur baith gaya, aap ne farmaya namaz bhi padhi? Mein ne kaha nahin. Farmaya khade ho jao aur do raka'at ada kar lo. Mein utha aur do raka'at padh kar baith gaya.

Aap ne farmaya: "Ae Abu Zar! Allah Ta'ala ki panah maango insaan Shaitanon aur jinn Shaitanon se." Main ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Kya insani Shaitan bhi hote hain?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Haan." Main ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Namaz kaisi cheez hai?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya: "Behtareen cheez hai, jo chahe kam kare jo chahe is amal ko ziyada kare." Main ne poocha: "Roza?" Farmaya: "Kaafi hone wala farz hai aur Allah ke paas ajr-o-sawab la-intiha hai." Main ne phir poocha: "Sadqa?" Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Bohat hi barha charha kar kai guna kar ke badla diya jaye ga." Main ne phir arz ki: "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Kaunsa sadqa afzal hai?" Farmaya: "Bawajood maal ki kami ke sadqa karna ya chipke se chhupa kar kisi miskeen faqeer ke sath sulook karna." Main ne sawal kiya: "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Sab se pehle Nabi kaun the?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam / A.S)." Main ne poocha: "Kya woh Nabi the?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Haan woh Nabi the aur woh bhi woh jin se Allah Ta'ala ne baat cheet ki." Main ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Rasool kitne hue?" Farmaya: "Teen sau kuch oopar das, bohat bari jama'at." Aur kabhi farmaya: "Teen sau pandrah." Main ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jo kuch aap par nazil kiya gaya un sab se bari azmat wali ayat kaunsi hai?" Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmaya: "Ayat-ul-Kursi (Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu, la ta'khuzuhu sinatuw-wa la naum, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man zal-lazi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-iznih, ya'lamu ma baina aideehim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuheetoona bi-shai'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-arda, wa la ya'ooduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azeem) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 255)." Yeh hadees Nasa'i mein bhi hai aur Abu Hatim bin Hibban ki Sahih Ibn Hibban mein to doosri sanad se doosre alfaaz ke sath yeh hadees bohat bari hai, Fallahu A'lam. Musnad Ahmad ki ek aur hadees shareef mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz kiya ke: "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mere dil mein to aise aise khayalaat aate hain ke un ka zaban se nikalna mujh par aasman se gir parne se bhi ziyada bura hai." Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar, Allah hi ke liye hamd-o-sana hai jis ne Shaitan ke makr-o-fareeb ko waswase mein hi lauta diya." Yeh hadees Abu Dawood aur Nasa'i mein bhi hai. Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ke ihsan se yeh tafseer khatam hui. Wal-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil 'Alameen, Allah ke fazl-o-karam se teeswein paare ki tafseer bhi khatam hui aur Tafseer Ibn Kathir ka tarjuma Tafseer Muhammadi bilkul kamil ho gaya. Allah Ta'ala hum sab ko apne paak kalam ki sahih samajh de aur is par amal naseeb farmaye aur phir qabool kare. Ameen Ilahal-Haqq Ameen! Wal-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil 'Alameen Was-Salatu Was-Salamu 'Ala Jamee'il-Mursaleen.

Khaliq, Parwarish Kuninda, Malik, Hukmran, Ma'bud-e-Haqiqi aur Panah Dehanda.

Is mein Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ki teen sifatein bayan hui hain, palne aur parwarish karne ki, malik aur shahanshah hone ki, ma'bud aur la'iq-e-ibadat hone ki. Tamam cheezein usi ki paida ki hui hain, usi ki milkiyat mein hain aur usi ki ghulami mein mashghool hain, pas woh hukm deta hai ke in pak aur bartar sifatein wale Allah ki panah mein aa jaye jo bhi panah aur bachao ka talib ho. Shaitan jo insan par muqarrar hai us ke waswason se wahi bachane wala hai, Shaitan har insan ke sath hai. Buraiyon aur badkariyon ko woh zeenat-dar kar ke logon ke samne woh pesh karta rehta hai aur behkane mein rah-e-rast se hatane mein koi kami nahin karta. Us ke shar se wahi mahfooz reh sakta hai jise Allah bacha le.

Sahih Hadith Shareef mein hai: Tum mein se har shakhs ke sath ek Shaitan hai. Logon ne kaha: Kya Aap ke sath bhi? Aap ne farmaya: Haan, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne us par meri madad farmai hai pas mein salamat rehta hoon, woh mujhe sirf neeki aur achhai ki baat hi kehta hai.

Bukhari Muslim ki aur hadith mein Hazrat Anas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki zabani ek waqia manqool hai jis mein bayan hai ke Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab i'tikaf mein the to Umm-ul-Mo'mineen Hazrat Safiyyah (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) Aap ke pas raat ke waqt aain, jab wapas jaane lagin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein awaz de kar thehraya aur farmaya: Suno! Mere sath meri biwi Safiyyah bint Huyayy (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) hain. Unhon ne kaha: SubhanAllah ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Is farman ki zaroorat hi kya thi? Aap ne farmaya: Insan ke khoon ke jari hone ki jagah Shaitan ghoomta phirta rehta hai, mujhe khayal hua ke kahin tumhare dilon mein woh koi badgumani na daal de.

Hafiz Abu Ya'la Mawsili (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne ek hadith warid ki hai jis mein hai Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Shaitan apna hath insan ke dil par rakhe hue hai, agar yeh Allah ka zikr karta hai tab to us ka hath hat jata hai aur agar yeh zikr-e-Allah bhool jata hai to woh us ke dil par poora qabza kar leta hai, yahii Waswas-ul-Khannas hai, yeh hadith ghareeb hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne gadhe par sawar ho kar kahin ja rahe the, ek Sahabi aap ke peeche baithe hue the, gadhe ne thokar khai to un ke muh se nikla Shaitan barbaad ho. Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yun na kaho, is se Shaitan phool kar bada ho jata hai aur kehta hai ke mein ne apni quwwat se gira diya, aur jab tum Bismillah kaho to woh ghat jata hai yahan tak ke makkhi ke barabar ho jata hai. Is se sabit hua ke zikr Allah se Shaitan past aur maghloob ho jata hai aur is ke chhod dene se woh bada ho jata hai aur ghalib aa jata hai.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab tum mein se koi masjid mein hota hai is ke paas Shaitan aata hai aur ise thapakta aur behlata hai jaise koi shakhs apne jaanwar ko behlata ho, phir agar woh khamosh raha to woh naak mein nakeel ya muh mein lagaam chadha deta hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne yeh Hadith bayan farma kar farmaya tum khud ise dekhte ho, nakeel wala to woh hai jo ek taraf jhuka khada hua aur Allah ka zikr na karta ho aur lagaam wala woh hai jo muh khole hue ho aur Allah ka zikr na karta ho.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain Shaitan Ibn-e-Aadam ke dil par changal maare hue hai, jahan yeh bhoola aur ghaflat ki ke is ne waswase daalne shuru kiye aur jahan is ne zikr Allah kiya aur yeh peeche hata. Sulaiman farmate hain mujh se yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke Shaitan rahat-o-ranj ke waqt insaan ke dil mein suraakh karna chahta hai yani ise behkana chahta hai, agar yeh Allah ka zikr kare to yeh bhaag khada hota hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Shaitan burai sikhata hai jahan insaan ne is ki maan li phir hat jata hai.
